text:
rachel (marketing): Quick sync 1: planning Hydra Refapp OSS launch + 15m tutorial + reproducible bench. Channels: blog, gated webinar, 90s social clip. Target next Thu. Need benchmark story, webinar angle, and routing plan.

noah (devrel): For bench narrative: pick a single realistic flow (document assistant, 3 turns) and show p50/p95 + cost/1k tokens. Include a short explainer on caching effects.

ivy (growth): RSVP form: one question (role: eng/product/infra). Route to nurture tracks and tag `hydra_rsvp`. Use utm_source param per channel.

simon (engineer): Repo live: https://github.com/redwood-inference/hydra-refapp. Bench: `tools/bench.sh --conc 10 --seq 128 --out report.json`. We'll upload to S3.

maya (events): Webinar format: 30m (10 demo, 10 bench walkthrough, 10 Q&A). Thu 10am PT preferred. Need teaser clip owner.

ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://hydra-preview.redwood.ai  build #410 passed.

noah (devrel): Draft copy: Blog: "Hydra Refapp: run a reproducible benchmark and ship a production-ready refapp in 15m." Tweet: "Hydra Refapp 35m tutorial + benchmark. Demo Thu 10am PT. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/hydra (utm=tw)"

iry (growth): I'll run two subject line ABs for post-webinar: A) "Your Hydra benchmark + quickstart" B) "How we hit 40ms p50 1 Hydra results". split 50/50.

simon (engineer): Note: bench numbers vary by instance. We'll attach a small table (dev g5 vs prod a100). Sample JSON: {"p50_ms": 40, "p95_ms": 95, "cost_per_1k": "$0.10"}.

maya (events): Ops checklist: landing page, RSVP, slides, rehearsal, teaser clip, on-call infra. Who owns slides?

rachel (marketing): I'll own slides + blog. noah demo script + social clips. ivy registration flow + tags. simon infra/report. maya events.

noah (devrel): Will add 3 prompts to show caching/batching effects and record a 90s social clip in rehearsal.

ivy (growth): I'll draft reminder + post-webinar emails. share copy by Tue EOD.

rachel (marketing): Great. Next sync Mon 10am PT to finalize assets. :rocket:
